Remark
1. Remark 2.4\group ch02-maximum-principles Source: han-lin-lecture-notes:page-0030

The boundedness of $\Omega $ and the hypothesis $c\le 0$ are essential in general; Dirichlet uniqueness can fail on an unbounded domain or when $c$ has positive part.
